player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ {max_rounds} round agorɔ mu wɔ Kuhn Poker.
Agorɔ Mmara:
- Kuhn Poker de 3-card deck a ɛwɔ J, Q, K (J ne titiriw, K ne kɛseɛ)
- Ɔmanfoɔ biara antes {ante} chip na ɔnya 1 card biara round (hwɛ na cards no wɔdeɛ wɔ replacement, enti wo ntuu ka card koro ne wo opponent).
- Agorɔ no kɔ so wɔ {max_rounds} rounds
- Ɔmanfoɔ a ɔwɔ sika kɛseɛ no nyinaa round akyi na ɔdi nkunim
Action Mmara:
- '[check]': Fa mu wɔ betting (efi sɛ bet biara nni table no so)
- '[bet]': Ka 1 chip kɔ pot no mu (efi sɛ bet biara nni table no so)
- '[call]': Di opponent bet biara kɔ pot no mu
- '[fold]': Gyae wo nsa na ma wo opponent no nyɛ pot no
